Hymn 249: Called to Serve
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Adam Geibel
Lyricist/Text Author: Grace Gordon
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 249 titled "Called to Serve" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Adam Geibel and the lyrics were written by Grace Gordon.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
